title: Programmatic CAD efficiency — text-to-cad demos are 10GB meshes from <3MB Python
summary: Jake argues programmatic CAD expresses complex geometry more efficiently: the text-to-cad repo ships about 10GB of demo models generated by under 3MB of Python scripts, citing a 12,000-line W16 engine as an example.
